59	      "page_level_design_instruction": "The Home page for Levante operates as a confident, structured landing experience that marries the corporate_clean aesthetic's precision and trustworthiness with the warmth of Mediterranean food culture. The page is built on a 12-column grid with a consistent horizontal gutter of 24px (desktop) / 16px (mobile), and a max-content width of 1200px centered on Levante White (#F7F8FA) as the dominant page canvas.

SECTION SEQUENCE AND RHYTHM:
The page moves through four deliberately varied skeleton types — a full-bleed anchored hero, a dashboard-panel feature grid, an asymmetric editorial split, and a full-bleed color-block close — ensuring no two consecutive sections share the same compositional logic. Density alternates: the hero is bold and spacious; the feature grid is structured and information-dense; the story block is editorial and sparse; the CTA close is saturated and minimal. This creates a page that breathes and accelerates in turn, consistent with the dashboard_product layout family's mix of metric panels and open editorial moments.

SIGNATURE MOMENT — "The Oversized Display Rule":
The page's signature moment lives in the hero section: the headline "Every Meal Deserves a Longer Table" is set at 72px (desktop) in Libre Franklin 700, left-aligned, with the word "Longer" rendered in Terracotta Ember (#C0674A) as an inline color break — not a CTA, not an eyebrow, but the headline itself carrying the accent. Beneath the headline, a full-width horizontal rule in Levant Sky (#3B82C4) at 3px weight spans the entire 12-column grid edge-to-edge (not padded to the content column) — a structural dashboard-inspired divider that bleeds to the container edge. This combination of warm typographic accent inside a cool structural rule is the page's defining visual gesture: it signals both the Mediterranean warmth and the corporate precision of the brand simultaneously. It is calibrated to corporate_clean's energy — not loud or ornamental, but decisive and confident.

COLOR AND SURFACE USAGE ACROSS SECTIONS:
— Section 1 (Hero): Aegean Navy (#1C2B4A) full-bleed background panel, white headline text with Terracotta Ember inline accent, Levant Sky rule as structural anchor.
— Section 2 (Feature Grid): Levante White (#F7F8FA) background; feature cards sit on Coastal Mist (#D6E4F0) fills with Marble Rule (#E2E8F0) card borders — the dashboard metric-card pattern from the layout family.
— Section 3 (Story Block): Levante White background with a left-side Aegean Navy vertical rule (4px, full column height) anchoring the editorial split — navy re-enters as a structural device, not a background.
— Section 4 (CTA Close): Aegean Navy full-bleed background, white display type, Levant Sky on the primary CTA button, Terracotta Ember as a thin top-border accent rule echoing the hero's rule motif.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY:
H1 (hero): Libre Franklin 700, 72px desktop / 44px mobile, tight tracking −0.02em, white with inline Terracotta Ember word.
H2 (section titles): Libre Franklin 600, 36px desktop / 28px mobile, Aegean Navy on light sections, white on dark sections.
H3 (feature card titles): Libre Franklin 600, 20px, Aegean Navy.
Eyebrow labels: IBM Plex Mono uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.12em, Levant Sky on light sections, Coastal Mist on dark sections.
Body copy: Source Sans 3 400, 16–17px, 1.65 line-height, Mezze Slate (#4A5568) on light sections, #D6E4F0 on dark.
CTA labels: Source Sans 3 600, 15px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em.

DENSITY AND WHITESPACE:
Hero: 120px vertical padding top/bottom (desktop), generous — the dark background makes it feel anchored, not empty.
Feature Grid: 80px top / 72px bottom; cards have 28px internal padding; 24px column gaps.
Story Block: 96px top / 96px bottom; single editorial column with deliberate negative space to the right.
CTA Close: 96px top / 96px bottom, centered composition (the only centered layout on the page — appropriate for a closing conversion beat).

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR:
At tablet (768–1024px): hero headline drops to 52px; feature grid collapses to 2-column; story block becomes single column with the vertical rule removed and replaced by a top border rule.
At mobile (<768px): hero headline at 38px; feature grid becomes single column; story block is full-width stacked; CTA close stacks buttons vertically. The Levant Sky structural rule in the hero collapses to the content width on mobile.

This page fits the shared design system by using every palette color purposefully, maintaining the Libre Franklin / Source Sans 3 / IBM Plex Mono typographic trio, and grounding every structural decision in either corporate_clean visual cues or dashboard_product structure cues — while the Terracotta Ember headline accent and the Mediterranean story content ensure the page never reads as generic fintech.",

      "page_level_design_instruction": "The Our Story page for Levante operates as a controlled editorial journey — structured and professional like the corporate_clean aesthetic demands, but given warmth and cultural depth through considered typographic expression, asymmetric rhythm, and strategic use of the full palette. The page moves through four distinctly composed sections that alternate between dense narrative and open declarative moments, preventing any templated repetition.

**Section Sequence and Rhythm:**
1. Page Header — masthead-style, left-anchored, typographically spare with a dramatic weight contrast. Opens the narrative register.
2. Story Block — the most content-dense section; asymmetric two-column split with the founding narrative on one side and a line-art map illustration on the other, plus a full-bleed Aegean Navy panel anchoring the bottom edge as a structural device.
3. Philosophy Feature Grid — a dashboard-product-style panel grid using metric-card logic to present four values; structured, data-panel feel applied to editorial content.
4. CTA Close — a centered, high-contrast Terracotta Ember full-bleed block that breaks the white/navy alternation and lands as a warm, confident invitation.

**Signature Moment:**
The page's signature moment lives in Section 2 (Story Block). A large-scale, cropped display numeral — "2019" — is set in Libre Franklin at approximately 160–180px, weight 700, in Coastal Mist (#D6E4F0), and positioned behind the founding narrative body text as a typographic background element. It bleeds off the right edge of the left column, partially obscured by the text layer above it. This is a dashboard-product structure cue (oversized metric / stat display) applied to an editorial context — a move that is entirely traceable to the layout_family's "metric cards" and "data modules" language, while the color choice (Coastal Mist rather than a loud accent) keeps it within corporate_clean's "subtle" and "stable" traits. It anchors the story in time without shouting, functioning as both a visual anchor and a typographic stunt.

**Color and Surface Usage:**
- Section 1: Levante White (#F7F8FA) background — clean, airy opening.
- Section 2: White surface for the narrative column; a right-side panel in Coastal Mist (#D6E4F0) holds the map illustration. The "2019" display numeral in Coastal Mist sits behind the text in the left column. A thin Marble Rule (#E2E8F0) hairline divides the section from the header above.
- Section 3: Levante White background with four feature cards using Coastal Mist fills and Marble Rule borders — consistent with the design system's card language.
- Section 4: Full-bleed Terracotta Ember (#C0674A) panel — the only warm, saturated surface on the page, providing a decisive tonal break that signals the end of the narrative and the invitation to act. Text in Levante White.

**Typography Hierarchy:**
- H1 (Section 1 headline): Libre Franklin 700, 52px, Aegean Navy, sentence case, −0.02em tracking.
- H2 (Section 2 headline): Libre Franklin 600, 36px, Aegean Navy.
- H2 (Section 3 headline): Libre Franklin 600, 34px, Aegean Navy.
- H2 (Section 4 headline): Libre Franklin 700, 44px, Levante White — centered, declarative.
- Body copy: Source Sans 3, 16–17px, 1.65 line-height, Mezze Slate for narrative text; Olive Press for footer-adjacent contexts.
- Eyebrow labels: IBM Plex Mono, 11px, uppercase, 0.12em letter-spacing, Levant Sky (#3B82C4) on white sections; Levante White at reduced opacity (80%) on the Terracotta Ember CTA.
- Section 3 card titles: Libre Franklin 600, 18–20px, Aegean Navy.
- Section 4 subheadline: Source Sans 3, 17px, Levante White, 500 weight.

**Density and Whitespace Logic:**
Section 1 is deliberately sparse — generous vertical padding (96px top, 80px bottom) with a narrow text column (max 640px) to set a contemplative pace. Section 2 is the densest section — the two-column split with body copy, the oversized numeral, and the map illustration fills the page with intentional weight. Section 3 returns to structured breathing room via the four-card grid with consistent internal padding. Section 4 is compact and focused — centered content, tight vertical padding (80px), two CTA buttons, no distraction.

**Responsive Behavior:**
On tablet (≤1024px): Section 2 stacks to single column — map illustration moves below the narrative text; the "2019" numeral scales to ~120px and remains behind the text block. Section 3 grid becomes 2×2. Section 4 remains centered, buttons stack vertically. On mobile (≤768px): All sections stack to single column. Section 1 headline scales to 36px. Section 2 numeral scales to 80px and shifts to sit above the body text as a decorative header element. Section 3 cards stack to 1×4. Section 4 headline scales to 32px.

This page shares the Levante White base, Aegean Navy structural anchors, Levant Sky eyebrow accents, and Marble Rule dividers with the rest of the site. Its distinctive contribution to the site rhythm is the Terracotta Ember CTA close (used here for the first time as a full-bleed panel) and the "2019" typographic stunt — both of which are earned by the editorial role of this page and would feel out of place on the transactional Menu or Contact pages.",
